scope: All 279 assessed V6 posts; V7/new collector rows excluded.
limitations: Public cross-check validates IDs, authors, publication dates and cycles; it does not independently verify every derived statistic.
Follows are source-reported historical profile-size values, not reach or exposure.
Only 8 repost counters are observed; impressions, reach, views, clicks and saves are explicitly not exposed.
Within-author comparisons are descriptive and use small authorship-format subsets; no causal inference.
Experience, message-origin and messenger-role do not exist as source-coded fields; outputs preserve them as uncoded.
Prospect funding labels are separate, dated records and are not current reference-account funding status.
